name: Jokshan
title: Abraham's son by Keturah
summary: Jokshan was one of the six sons Abraham had with his second wife, Keturah, after Sarah's death. His descendants became ancestors to several Arab tribes and peoples in the Middle East. Through him, God's promise to Abraham that he would become the father of many nations was partially fulfilled.

keyEvents.title: Birth of Jokshan
keyEvents.description: Jokshan was born as a son of Abraham and Keturah, as part of Abraham's extended family after Sarah's death.

keyEvents.title: The Sons of Jokshan
keyEvents.description: Jokshan had two sons, Sheba and Dedan, who became ancestors of merchants and tribes in Arabia.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Dedan
keyEvents.description: Through his son Dedan came the tribes Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim, who settled in Arabia.

keyEvents.title: Abraham's Inheritance Distribution
keyEvents.description: Abraham gave gifts to Jokshan and his brothers but sent them away from Isaac toward the east, to secure Isaac's position as the primary heir.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jokshan and his descendants are also recorded in the genealogies of Chronicles as part of Abraham's family.
